steps.name: IngestFromGlb
steps.label: Ingest Textures From GLB
steps.goal:
If no textures exist in the tex render dir, find the latest published
dsn GLB, import it, split and unpack its embedded PBR maps, and write a
TexData MSD to the render dir — so the tex publish recipe can proceed
exactly as if Substance had exported the textures.

Skips silently when textures are already present (idempotent).  Fails
if no dsn GLB publish exists yet.
steps.min_scenario: Textures already exported by Substance — step skips immediately.
steps.max_scenario: No textures exist; must hunt down the GLB, manually unpack each embedded image, split the ORM map, rename every file to the naming convention, and write the MSD by hand.

steps.name: CreateVersionMsd
steps.label: Create Version MSD
steps.goal:
Build and commit the TexData version manifest.

Reads the TexData MSD written by IngestFromGlb (or a prior Substance
export) from the render dir, validates it via the blender tex SmartTask,
and writes the version manifest so downstream tasks can read it via
``task_object.version_msd.data``.
steps.max_scenario: Texture structure is wrong; you fix the file layout by hand before the manifest can be written.

steps.name: Publish
steps.label: Publish
steps.goal:
Publish the tex version: copy to publish/latest and mirror to the
tracker. Description defaults to a GLB-ingest note when set by
IngestFromGlb, or a generic tex publish otherwise.
steps.min_scenario: You manually copy the version to publish/latest and a coordinator updates the tracker.
steps.max_scenario: The coordinator is slammed and forgets; downstream waits days for a notification that never comes.

Task() class usage and important variables.

variables:
path_object = this is the path object for the "scene".  this distinction becomes important if you're in the "shot" context
and need to keep track of what "shot" you're in, while also working on a "task" ie: 'mld', 'rig', 'anm'
msd_path = this is the path to the msd file for the current task.  ie: if you're working on the mld task, this will be the path to the mld msd file.
task = this is the name of the task.  ie: 'mld', 'rig', 'anm'
task_object = the task object allows you to work in context of the task. ie: if you are working on the mld task, it will allow you to get the latest mld publish, or the latest mld msd file.
dcc = this is the dcc we are working in.  ie: 'maya', 'houdini', 'nuke'

steps.name: CheckForReviewFiles
steps.label: Check For Review Files
steps.goal:
Locate the render image sequence to review (prefers ``playblast``) and
stash its printf pattern + frame range in shared_data for downstream steps.
steps.min_scenario: You set up the camera/settings and capture the media by hand, then drop it where reviewers look — when it works first try.
steps.max_scenario: Settings are off or reviewers can't find it; you re-capture and re-share, and review slips.
